notes: Starter guide written by `stylelock init`. Every value below is a placeholder for a clean flat-vector look - replace them with a description of YOUR approved art, then set status to active.
Describe what the art IS, measured from real approved images, not what you hope it will be. Pull palette hexes from the files themselves.
Once active this file is immutable: change the style with `stylelock style bump`.
subject_domain: illustrations for a product - say what they are for and who sees them

palette.description: a small fixed palette of saturated, friendly colours

colors.name: ink navy
colors.role: darkest value, used sparingly for depth

rules: accents cover well under a tenth of the image
no colours outside the palette apart from lighter and darker steps of its own hues

rendering.line_weight: no outlines - shapes are defined by fills alone
rendering.shading: one or two flat tone steps per shape, no gradients

lighting.key: soft, even daylight from the upper left
lighting.avoid: glow, bloom, rim light or dramatic shadows

composition.background: simple and quieter than the subject

avoid: photorealism, 3D renders, clay or plastic materials
hard_rules: there is no text anywhere in the image - no words, letters, numerals, captions, labels, signage or logos

composition.structure: a complete environment filling the whole canvas, edge to edge
composition.negative_space: calm areas where interface elements can sit
composition.background: the scene itself - no border, no vignette

object.description: A single prop or character isolated on a transparent background, for compositing.

composition.structure: one subject, complete and unclipped, centred
composition.background: none at all; alpha transparency only

object.append: Draw ONE subject only, complete and centred on a fully transparent background. No ground plane, no cast shadow, no scenery, no backdrop.

icon.description: A square interface icon on a transparent background.

composition.structure: one bold symbol, centred, filling about 80% of the canvas
composition.background: none at all; alpha transparency only

icon.append: One bold, instantly readable symbol. No background shape unless the guide asks for one.

references.notes: Anchors are sent with every call. Add 2-5 of your best on-style images with `stylelock refs add <file> --role anchor --demonstrates '...'`.
